_note: Run log for the previous-events backfill. A later run appends to runs, keeps included events, and can stop once the countries and years stop yielding new credited events. This file does not publish events by itself.
date_only: Rows whose source states a date and no clock time are stored as 00:00–23:59 in the event's offset so the site shows the day. That clock is not a claimed start or end time.
counts_rule: attendees and speakers_count stay empty unless the source states an exact integer. Capacity and wording such as approximately, estimated, over or limited to are not counts.

runs.note: Five previous events from organiser or university pages. The Satoshi speech page states 11 February at 18:00 and the page is dated 6 February 2026, so the year is 2026. It does not state a closing time; the end clock is the day bound, not a claimed finish. The Internetdagarna speaker page states 24 Nov at 11:40 in Bar5 and no closing time, so that row has no end. Open Knowledge Sweden, writing the same day, places the conference at Stockholm Waterfront Congress Centre in Stockholm; the room on the row is Bar5 from the speaker page. Arendalsuka 10 August 2026 is stated on the BPI page dated 16 July 2026. The 12 August 2025 mining debate is dated on the BPI newsletter archive and the closing time is on Kristiania's Arendalsuka 2025 programme. Capacity of 140 seats was not stored. Faroe Islands, Greenland and Åland were searched again and still have no dated public crypto event. Taper level unchanged: full.

When none matches, a previous event is created from facts the video page stated: name, day, city, country, venue, organiser and official URL. A talk with no day or no place stays unlinked with unlink_reason. Predatory conference listings are not sources.
